similar_bugs.title: Historical Bug
similar_bugs.description: Created by Suneetha Yerneni suneetha hilco com on Friday July 24 1998 9 26 23 AM PDT Additional Details When tried running applets through netscape it uses the system resources each time the applet is loaded and eventually the netscape crashes as all the system resources are used Is there a way which works as a garbage collector and which releases the resources in Netscape This problem doesnot occur when I use Internet explorer Reassing Marc Byrd s mozilla bugs to Jean Charles for proper routing

similar_bugs.title: Historical Bug
similar_bugs.description: Created by Rick Downes mozilla radsoft net on Thursday July 16 1998 6 15 35 AM PDT Additional Details Seems you guys haven t really gotten multithreading Nowadays you ve got so much going on in this mutating app that even at exit there are threads running accessing things which other threads do their politest to clean up and destroy With all these threads running you must find a way of synchronising the ExitProcess call either directly or indirectly by waiting on all running threads to exit sign
